blocks.prompt: 12 i. The stresses in a metal plate are represented by the homogeneous equation \(3x^{2} - 8xy - 3y^{2} = 0\). Show that this equation represents a pair of straight lines through the origin. Find: the equations of lines represented by this equation.
blocks.explanation:
Metal plate ke stresses ki directions yahan origin se guzarne wali do lines se represent ho rahi hain.
Is hisse mein do kaam hain: pehle dikhana ke yeh waqai origin se guzarne wali do seedhi lines hain, phir un ki equations nikalna.
Rule: 'dikhane' ke liye Theorem 8 aur \(h^{2} - ab\) ka test; lines ke liye middle term split.
Plan: degree check, \(a\), \(h\), \(b\), test, phir factorization.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(3x^{2} - 8xy - 3y^{2} = 0\).
Dikhana: yeh origin se guzarne wali do seedhi lines hain. Maloom karna: woh lines.
Tareeqa: Theorem 8 se 'dikhana', aur middle term split kar ke lines. Pehle theory se faisla, phir hisaab se tasdeeq.

Dikhayein ke yeh origin se guzarne wali do lines hain
\[a = 3,\quad h = -4,\quad b = -3\]
\[h^{2} - ab = 16 + 9 = 25 > 0\]
Kyun: har term (\(x^{2}\), \(xy\), \(y^{2}\)) ki degree 2 hai, to yeh degree 2 ki homogeneous equation hai. Theorem 8 kehta hai aisi har equation origin se guzarne wali do lines hoti hai, aur \(h^{2} > ab\) hone ki wajah se lines real aur alag hain.
Dhyan dein: \(-ab = -(3)(-3) = +9\), is liye 16 mein 9 jama hua.

Middle term split karein
\[3x^{2} - 9xy + xy - 3y^{2} = 0\]
Kyun: aise numbers chahiye jin ka product \(3 \times (-3) = -9\) aur jama \(-8\) ho: woh \(-9\) aur \(1\) hain.

Factorize karein
\[3x(x - 3y) + y(x - 3y) = 0\]
\[(3x + y)(x - 3y) = 0\]
Kyun: pehle jore se \(3x\) aur doosre se \(y\) common nikala; dono ne same bracket \((x - 3y)\) chhora.

Lines
\[3x + y = 0 \quad \text{aur} \quad x - 3y = 0\]
Kyun: zero-product rule; dono mein constant term nahi, is liye dono \((0, 0)\) se guzarti hain. Yahi 'dikhana' bhi poora karta hai.

Tasdeeq:
\[(3x + y)(x - 3y) = 3x^{2} - 9xy + xy - 3y^{2}\]
\[= 3x^{2} - 8xy - 3y^{2} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: multiply kiya to di gayi equation wapas aa gayi. Is ka matlab factorization bilkul sahi hai, aur ab inhi do lines ke darmiyan angle part (ii) mein nikalenge.
blocks.final_answer: Yeh origin se guzarne wali do real aur alag lines hain (\(h^{2} - ab = 25 > 0\)): \(3x + y = 0\) aur \(x - 3y = 0\)

blocks.prompt: 12 ii. The stresses in a metal plate are represented by the homogeneous equation \(3x^{2} - 8xy - 3y^{2} = 0\). Show that this equation represents a pair of straight lines through the origin. Find: angle between them.
blocks.explanation:
Ab part (i) wali dono lines ke darmiyan angle chahiye.
Coefficients par aik nazar daalein: \(x^{2}\) ka 3 aur \(y^{2}\) ka \(-3\), jama zero.
Rule: Section 5.9 ka special case: \(a + b = 0\) ho to lines perpendicular.
Plan: \(a + b\) dekhna, formula ka matlab samajhna, aur slopes se tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(3x^{2} - 8xy - 3y^{2} = 0\), lines \(3x + y = 0\) aur \(x - 3y = 0\).
Maloom karna: un ke darmiyan angle.
Tareeqa: \(\tan\theta = \dfrac{2\sqrt{h^{2}-ab}}{a + b}\); jab \(a + b = 0\) ho to lines perpendicular hoti hain. Yeh sab se tez raasta hai.

\(x^{2}\) aur \(y^{2}\) ke coefficients ka jama
\[a + b = 3 + (-3) = 0\]
Kyun: yahi formula (iv) ka denominator hai.

Angle
\[\tan\theta = \dfrac{2(5)}{0} \text{ undefined hai}\]
\[\theta = 90^{\circ}\]
Kyun: zero se divide nahi hota, yani \(\tan\theta\) defined nahi; aur tan sirf \(90^{\circ}\) par undefined hota hai. Yahi \(a + b = 0\) wala special case hai.
Dhyan dein: '\(\tan\theta = 0\)' samajh kar \(0^{\circ}\) likhna ghalat hai; zero numerator mein nahi, denominator mein hai.

Tasdeeq:
\[m_{1} = -3,\quad m_{2} = \dfrac{1}{3}\]
\[m_{1}m_{2} = -1 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(3x + y = 0\) se \(y = -3x\) aur \(x - 3y = 0\) se \(y = \frac{1}{3}x\). Slopes ka product \(-1\) hai, to lines waqai perpendicular hain. Physics ki zubaan mein: plate ke andar yeh do stress directions aapas mein bilkul seedhe kone (right angle) par hain, jaise kamre ki deewar aur farsh.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein is sawal ka jawab number 13 par ('\(3x + y = 0\), \(x - 3y = 0\), \(90^{\circ}\)') chhapa hai, jo sahi hai; sirf numbering ek aage khiski hui hai.
